name: provide an untouched self-test entry that returns a success sentinel
definition: ship a smoke-test routine that constructs the model, performs a forward, prints a success marker, surfaces failures, and returns truthy, with no broad exception swallowing.
failure_mode: a smoke-test absent or faking completion without executing breaks the introspection check

name: read and auto-replay the recovered WAL into the database
definition: Point sqlite at the database so on open it replays the restored journal, producing the full merged record set (baseload plus appended/updated records) in id order.
failure_mode: Filtering the journal or not flushing means records still missing.

name: reassemble a hexdump output back into a binary artifact
definition: Take the bytes of a hexdump file and reconstruct the underlying binary file so it can be inspected as a real executable.

name: record vim macros under a total keystroke budget
definition: create macro registers containing editing sequences whose combined lengths stay under a fixed keystroke ceiling
failure_mode: over-budget or unoptimized macros risk timing out
